errors.text_span: 最大的切片为浅绿色，代表《域外汉籍研究集刊》
errors.evidence: In the image, the largest slice (67%) representing 域外汉籍研究集刊 is a teal/dark green color, not light green (浅绿色). The light green color appears to represent 汉籍与汉学.
汉籍与汉学 is represented by a light green color, not dark green (深绿色). The dark green is used for 域外汉籍研究集刊.
Based on the reference and image, 文献 is described as blue (蓝色), not orange.
Based on the legend ordering, 图书馆论坛 (5th in left legend) appears to be a different color; the reference describes 图书馆论坛 as 青色 and 文学遗产 as 紫色. The color assignments for these two appear swapped.
The reference describes 文学遗产 as purple (紫色), not red.

The description states the legend is on both the left and right sides ('图表左侧和右侧分别列出了期刊名称'), which is correct, but the reference notes that all slices have percentage labels annotated on them — the machine description mentions this but does not note the absence of any visual emphasis or slice offset (exploded slices), which the reference explicitly mentions.

The machine description omits 图书馆杂志 from the list of named journals and replaces it with different entries. According to the reference, 图书馆杂志 (橙褐色) has 3%, but the machine description doesn't list it and instead lists 图书馆论坛 at 3%.
